In addition, they must request admission to the Double Degree programme by addressing their application to the head of that programme at the Department of Italian of the University of Fribourg before 30 September of the first semester of the master's course. The application must include: a cover letter, a curriculum vitae, the transcripts of the applicant's bachelor's course marks, as well as documentation attesting their knowledge of Italian to B2 level (e.g. a PLIDA certificate from the Società Dante Alighieri ; a self-assessment for students who completed their Matura in Italian).
